verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a native CRM integration (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio) that syncs meeting notes or summaries onto contact or deal records. The Developer API, webhooks and MCP server are developer building blocks a customer could use to build such a sync, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, meeting notes and summaries sync automatically onto the right contact and deal records in my CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio)
